reviews.comment: I honestly think Giles is a very nice person but she is not a great professor. Lectures are very monotone. She seems unorganized constantly moving due dates. Instructions are never clear. Power point slides are very confusing and she doesnt do a great job explaining them so you pretty much have to teach yourself from scratch in this course.

Dr. Giles has become my favorite prof by far! Yes, her class is difficult, but she teaches well and is so easy to approach!! She also provides a lot of resources so students can learn the material well. I wouldnt skip class though because participation counts toward your grade. But if you ever have the chance to take Dr. Giles, DO IT!

Dr. Giles' class was so much work, but she was awesome! She let us pick our own topic to research for the semester. Very few lectures. Mostly listening to presentations and writing a research paper. She's pretty fair with grades. Very helpful when I asked questions outside of class. I thought she was great.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
